summary: Bound work acknowledgement hierarchy reads and remove unused harness acknowledgement dispatch

replay.detail: No source, projection, retention or replay changes.

schema.detail: Uses the existing desired primary key and named-subject lookup. No new tables or indexes.

rules.detail: Lease, incarnation, ownership, admission and idempotency checks remain unchanged; acknowledgements follow durable commit.

compatibility.detail: Work and harness response shapes, core list/filter/get semantics and timeline usage rollup publication including retries remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; no migration or startup backfill.

recovery.detail: No new persisted state; ordinary rollback to prior binary remains available.
